name: lte-setup
description: [DEPRECATED — use the 'usb-net' module] LTE mobile data via USB Ethernet. Superseded by usb-net, which ships the universal ASIX driver (incl. AX88772B/C) and an 'lte' mode that does the same DLinkReplacesPPP + DNS setup. The old AX88772B/D override scripts never worked on io-net and have been removed.
author: dspl1236
scripts: lte_setup.sh - Configure fair/DLINK mode for USB Ethernet + persistent root shell on port 2323
lte_restore.sh - Remove fair mode, shell, restore factory PPP config
lte_status.sh - Diagnose USB Ethernet, DHCP, DNS, connectivity

hardware.adapter: ASIX AX88772 / 772A (for 772B/772C use the usb-net module)
hardware.router: TP-Link TL-MR3020 or any router on 192.168.0.1 subnet

notes: DEPRECATED -> usb-net. Based on DrGER2/MMI3GP-LAN-Setup. Creates DLinkReplacesPPP flag, enables DHCP on en5, installs dhcp-up for DNS. MMI3G High does NOT have the ASIX driver — 3G+ / RNS-850 only. lte_restore.sh retained to undo a prior LTE setup.
